summary: The Host Identity Protocol CERT parameter carries digital certificates in HIP control packets. This experimental document defines it and the error signaling for failed verification. It also describes how to represent Host Identity Tags in X.509 v3 and SPKI. It was replaced by RFC 8002.

eli5.summary: Computers using HIP prove who they are with ID cards. This says where in the messages to put the card and how to complain if it is bad. It was later replaced by RFC 8002.

questions: how are certificates carried in hip
